about: 580 agent colors: 20 families x 10 base tones (ids 0-199) plus 5 half-step extension tones (ids 200-299) 4 more (ids 300-379) 5 more (ids 380-479) and 5 more (ids 480-579), OKLCH. Assigned by tools/roster.mjs: original agents in department order on the base tones, wave-2 agents on the first extension tones of their department's family, wave-3 and wave-4 agents on the free tones nearest their department's family, each wave limited to the tones that existed when it arrived.
